name: Padise Monastery
description: A Cistercian monastery estate shown before the April 1343 attack and as a burned, silent site after it.

phase_states.description: White Brother choir monks and Grey Brother lay monks keep the oratory, hospital, brewery, and well in use with a Latin liturgical soundscape.
The 23 April fire leaves the monastery empty and the soundscape turns to a restrained, desolate monastery theme.

source_notes.summary: Padise was an active Cistercian monastery with choir monks and lay brothers before the 1343 attack; the permanent exhibition records 28 monks killed and buildings burned.
